$comment: Versioned performance budgets for CircleUp. Update only with measurement evidence.

api.$comment: Indexer query and response budgets measured against the fixture dataset (50 circles, 10 members each)

circleList.$comment: Max DB query time for GET /circles with 50 rows
Max JSON response size for 50 circles

bundle.$comment: Next.js page JS budgets (gzipped). Measured with `next build` output. Exceptions documented below.

homePage.$comment: Includes React runtime and shared chunks

createPage.$comment: stellar-sdk adds ~15 KB gzipped; exception granted until tree-shaking is implemented

render.$comment: Component render time budgets in ms measured in jsdom (vitest). These are ceiling values, not targets.

payload.$comment: Wire payload size budgets (uncompressed) for the initial circle list in different states
